text:
alex: Quick note — noticed an oddity in the Android Kotlin SDK: when switching networks (wifi->cell) mid-request, OkHttp reports `IOException: Connection reset` and our retry logic immediately replays the request. For non-idempotent streaming/long-poll endpoints this causes duplicate side effects and duplicate token refreshes.

nora: Which OkHttp/Retrofit versions and sampleapp?

alex: okhttp 4.11 + retrofit 2.9 in sampleapp-v2. Repro: start a 45s poll to /v1/poll, toggle wifi off mid-run, call dies fast with: 
```
E/OkHttp: java.io.IOException: Connection reset by peer
   at okhttp3.internal.connection.ExchangeFinder.findConnection(ExchangeFinder.kt:...)
   at okhttp3.internal.connection.RealCall.execute(RealCall.kt:...)
Caused by: java.net.SocketException: Connection reset by peer
```

sam: Sounds like the system tears down socket on network handoff. Our SDK treats that as transient and retries right away. If a token refresh occurs concurrently, we get duplicate refresh requests and sometimes a 401 loop.

nora: Two immediate mitigations: 1) disable automatic `retryOnConnectionFailure` in mobile defaults and 2) add singleflight mutex around token refresh so only one refresh happens. Also surface a FailureReason (USER_CANCEL, SYSTEM_CANCEL, NETWORK_CHANGE, TIMEOUT) so callers can choose behavior.

alex: I can prototype: set retryOnConnectionFailure(false) for streaming/unary differentiation, add 200ms jitter before retry when the error message contains "Connection reset" and expose FailureReason.

sam: Also recommend adding an EventListener hook to emit cancel reason labels to telemetry so we can get counts (network-change vs manual cancel).

ci-bot: Created issue SDK-2024: "Android SDK: prevent blind retries on system-induced network cancellations; add singleflight token refresh" (<https://issues.redwood/SDK-2024>)

nora: Great. Assign to eng-devx, add matrix: Android 11-14, wifi<->cell, VPN toggle. Update onboarding docs to call out `retryOnConnectionFailure` caveats.

alex: Will open PR with sampleapp changes and minimal repro steps attached. Thanks.
